component.name: Moydan
component.summary: Scroll, play, save and remix tiny browser games

description.p: Moydan is an open-source social platform for short, immediately playable browser games. Every item in the vertical feed is a game you can play in place: react to it, comment on it, save it, share it, follow the creator, and remix it with your own parameters or source.

This Flatpak is the desktop shell for a Moydan deployment. Point it at your own instance and the feed, saved games, profiles and the creator studio all work exactly as they do in a browser. Games themselves run in a separate, sandboxed origin provided by the deployment.
Set the server address from the "Server" button in the header bar, or with the MOYDAN_SERVER_URL environment variable.
